name: neve-source-retrieval-bd
description: Everyday tenancy questions, in English and in colloquial Bangla, against the real legal corpus in backend/legal-corpus (official text of the Premises Rent Control Act, 1991 and Chapter V of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882). Labels are <source>:<section>; a case passes when every expected section is among the top k retrieved (read recall@k). Expected sections were chosen by the development team from the section text and still need checking by a qualified legal reviewer. They mark where the answer is found, not what the answer is.
